title: Chapter 543
paragraphs: Chapter 543
145. Precursor (12)
Being seen through by a young man, who is far behind in rank and lacking in age and experience, is certainly a blow to one's pride.
However, Kelliark did not show any sign of injured pride, but just exposed his honest hatred with a fading smile.
That deep and dreadful hatred was like a swamp, so much so that Jin felt his body become heavier just by facing it.
And Kelliark deliberately showing his hatred was proof that he acknowledged Jin.
'Indeed, a sense of oppression befitting the absolute being of the Zipple.'
Hatred.
Looking back at what had happened, Kelliark had no reason not to hate Jin.

Starting from killing the Zipple followers when leaving Storm Castle, impersonating in Tesing, learning Chenmi's erased magic, killing Andrei, destroying the Magic Stone, the massacre of the Colonne natives, wiping out the Dark Magic Association, inheriting Liol Zipple's legacy, stealing the compass, incidents in the Holy Kingdom, the Western Sea battle, the tombs of Temar, killing the Spectral Great, removing Barton, the Wanta Lamore Forest, the Gaipa Military Road, the Sota Desert, and even this moment.
Everything Jin has done since his regression is, without exception, literally a history that has blocked the way for Kelliark and the Zipple.

Killing Kidard Hall and monopolizing his magic also indirectly hit Zipple, and though Kelliark doesn't know it yet, Valeria Hister, who Zipple so desperately desires, is only in a relationship with Jin.

Even Veradin is resisting mind manipulation under Jin's influence, and Jin has also openly denied the humiliating alliance Runcandel made with Zipple through the declaration of the Return of the Magic Sword.
There wasn't a single reason for Zipple not to hate Jin.
'This hatred is probably why you couldn't reach the realm of Genesis that my father reached....'
Just as Jin seemed to be seeing through Kelliark,
He was also looking through Jin.

'He is outstanding, in and of itself. If the Solderet breaks our alliance and joins Runcandel, it would naturally be because of Chiron or Luna... Jin Runcandel, seeing you in person, I understand why Solderet chose you instead of those two.'
Kelliark was even willing to feel resentment towards Chiron.
He had been shadowed by him all his life, staying at number two, and even the next generation, his children, couldn't surpass his legacy.
"When we talk about you at the Tower of Stories... My kin thought I took you lightly. It's a bit empty that you're reading my hatred that even they didn't realize."
"Shouldn't you have kept more competent and deeper people by your side?"
For the knights of the Vamel Alliance and Sword Emperor Castle, Jin's responses felt like fuel in front of a fire.

They were worried if it wasn't too provocative to confront Kelliark, who had just crippled Kalmain with a single attack, and demonstrated the power to annihilate the entire Sword Emperor Castle in seconds.
But Jin knew.
He knew that no matter what, he wouldn't attack the Sword Emperor City until the negotiation was over.

'If he had intended to demolish the Sword Emperor City with brute force and take the White Stone without compromise, he wouldn't have started the conversation in the first place. Kelliark Zephyr is wary of a head-on confrontation with Runcandel.'
There could have been several reasons, such as the existence of Cirron, the power of Runcandel, the strength of Kinzelo, etc.

'Perhaps Kelliark also realizes that if he's not careful, a monster of chaos could wake up from the White Stone. No, definitely. He knows the value of the White Stone better than any of us. That's why he wants it.'
Therefore, Kelliark must have wanted to resolve the situation through negotiation with Sword Emperor City (effectively Runcandel) without as much as possible military collision.

In fact, just by bringing out the card of 'negotiation', Zephyr's external prestige was plummeting. It was an unusual occurrence for the world's number one family to prioritize negotiation over fighting, even after losing so many dragons, wizards, and fleets.
'More than anything, I can't see the figure of the Fire Dragon Kadun.'
Fire Dragon Kadun.
The strongest fire dragon created by the god of fire, Shinnu. Jin had been conscious of not seeing Kadun's figure from a while ago.
Of course, Kadun could be onboard the fleet, transformed into a human. However, Jin judged that the possibility was very low.

'It's strange to place the strongest fire dragon out of sight, after setting an enormous flame magic around the entire fleet, pretending not to know, spreading fire over the entire Sword Emperor City to create a sense of oppression and show off.'
Among the about fifty fleets led by Kelliark, the dragons of Zephyr were mixed. There was no reason for Kadun not to show off his might at the center.
However, Jin found it difficult to infer the reason why Kelliark 'did not bring Kadun'.

'Is it because the absence of Kadun causes problems in Zephyr's air defense? No, even if negotiation is prioritized, it wouldn't completely rule out a full-scale war. So that can't be the reason. Then…….'
Suddenly, Jin recalled the name of another friend.
'Did Veradin take some action to prevent Kadun from being included in the fleet......?'
It was accurate.
Veradin is currently in a situation where he has to be protected by Kadun by forcing himself to go berserk.
Therefore, Kelliark had no choice. If Veradin is destroyed, all the plans Zephyr had been preparing for could go awry.
Jin didn't know that fact, but for some reason, he had a strong feeling that the absence of Kadun was the result of his friend's sacrifice.
"You're aware of Kadun's absence."
Jin almost revealed a surprised expression at those words.
"I've heard that Kyung can only use perfect flame with the power of that dragon."
"It's not the Guardian Dragon but the Phoenix that makes a perfect wizard who handles fire."
Whiiiing-!
Suddenly, a phoenix revealed itself behind Kelliark. It was 'Belot', reputed to be the strongest along with Tess, Maniere, and Sankish.
Indeed, it was the summon of the one who had reached the pinnacle of magic. Belot, larger and more blazing than any record, cast a dark shadow over Gomhwangseong.
Literally, it was full of fire.
The Vamel Union and Gomhwangseong felt as if they had to fight against not Zipple but the god of fire, Shinnu himself, in the face of the fleet that filled the night sky and Belot's blaze.
A fire even greater than the legacy of Riol Zipple shown by Jin through the mirror and the will of the two gods was completely dyeing their vision red.
However, Jin did not falter.
"Strangely, I think you would know what my phoenix is."
"The only god of the flame realm and the master of all phoenixes. But you can't handle his power properly yet."
This was a moment when Kelliark admitted Jin in front of everyone. Because the expression 'yet' implied the possibility of the future.
"If you really think so, blow up my head right now. I'm curious if the power given by your god, Shinnu, can penetrate Tess's absolute domain."
"As I heard, you are quite thick-skinned. It's commendable courage to bluff so openly against me."
Kelliark realized that Jin could not summon Tess at this moment.
Jin felt goosebumps knowing this fact and that he was fully aware of it. Although neither of them spoke such words, it was a domain that could be known instinctively.
"Kelliark, you seem to be more cautious than I heard. I see that you do not use a spatial explosion on me because of the slim possibility that I can summon Tess."
"I'm not blowing up your head just for you."
Kelliark smiled again.
Now, his smile was filled not only with hatred but also with ease.
"Jin Lunekendel."
"Please speak."
"You generously vowed not to catch fleeing enemies. I will also show the same mercy. Let Hairan leave the White Stone and Gomhwangseong right now. Then no one will die."
Whooosh!
A small flame formed on Kelliark's finger. He wrote in the air with the flame, which was the 'Seal of Fire' that only the contractor of Shinnu could handle.

At the same time, Zipple swore to rescue Dante Hairan, who was eroded by the White Stone, through all the efforts that the family could mobilize, and if he survived, he would definitely send him back to Hairan.
Everyone standing in Gomhwangseong stared at those glowing red letters.
"In addition, if you accept my conditions, Zipple will do its best to destroy the imperial family that betrayed Hairan."
Without any room to ponder how Kelliark knew Dante's condition, the knights of Hairan had no choice but to be shaken for the first time since the situation began.
The promise to destroy the empire wasn't very important.
However, if there was something more precious than the pride that the knights of Hairan would defend even at the cost of their lives, it was the life of the crown prince.
Using the Fire Seal meant that Kelliark was swearing on his god, Shinnu. The condition offered by Kelliark was undoubtedly sincere.
"Zipple knows a way to save Dante Hairan. I can't guarantee that we can save him unconditionally, but we can ensure a success rate of at least 80%."
Jin immediately opened his mouth towards the knights of Hairan.
"It's a trap. There's definitely no lie in Sir Kelliark's oath, but..."
The moment Hairan accepts the condition, Hairan will not be destroyed by Zipple but by Runcandel. Sir Kelliark omitted the promise to protect Hairan from Runcandel.
He could not bring himself to utter the rest of the sentence.
For Runcandel, it was natural to attack Hairan if they accepted Zipple's conditions.
In that case, Runcandel would have to stand by and watch Zipple get the white stone without gaining anything.
Rosa wouldn't stand by and watch that. She was a person who would not retreat even if the Kingdom of Swords and the lands of Hairan were all turned to ashes.
And for Jin to stop such a Rosa.
It would be a betrayal of Runcandel.
'You've laid a good trap... Kelliark Zipple.'
Objectively, Jin and Runcandel could not offer Hairan better conditions.
Runcandel did not have a way to save Dante, and among the Runcandels, only Jin valued Dante's life.
For Runcandel, as long as the White Stone did not go to Zipple, it didn't matter whether Hairan disappeared from history or not.
Jin gritted his teeth, and Kelliark was certain of his victory with a calm face.
Kelliark's gaze landed on Luyan.
"Now, I'll give Hairan a chance to talk with me. What do you say, Luyan? There's no better condition for the Kingdom of Swords."
For a while, Luyan silently looked up at Kelliark.
"Hairan is... and the knights who gathered for Hairan are..."
Just as Luyan was about to continue.
I refuse, Kelliark Zipple.
A voice that everyone in this land knew well, and a voice that everyone wished with all their heart to be able to fight together with...
The voice of a giant quietly, but deeply and majestically echoed in the sky.
Everyone turned to look at the owner of the voice, who had just climbed up the wall.
"Who dares to say they can save Hairan and my grandson in my stead? That is only allowed for me."
There was the Sword Emperor.
Ron Hairan stood tall.
